title: Multi-Period Texture Contrast Enhancement for Low-Contrast Wafer Defect Detection and Segmentation
mechanism: MPTCE: reconstruct the dominant periodic component of a feature map in the frequency domain, take abs(F - F_periodic) as a disturbance map, turn its gradient into attention, and output F + alpha*A*F.
adaptation: Insert after ResNet-34 layer1 (128 px) and layer2 (64 px), where the finger pitch is still resolvable. Pick the top-k spectral peaks per channel per image so half-cut layouts adapt. Optionally supervise the disturbance map weakly with crack + gridline masks.
min_experiment: Arm: PF + MPTCE at layer1/2, 5 seeds. Baseline: PF. Metric: gridline IoU, crack pixel precision, crack IoU. Kill: gridline < +0.03 and crack IoU < +0.012.
evidence: R: wafer data, 4,531 RGB images, 7 classes, YOLOv8-seg base. MPTCE alone: recall 71.2 -> 73.7, mAP50 72.7 -> 76.2, mAP50-95 47.9 -> 51.1. Full model +8.3 mAP50-95, false positives -8.6%.
prior_overlap: none in BRIEF section 5. D08 also lists it.

alt_notes.adaptation: Fingers and busbars are periodic, cracks and inactive are not: add the periodic-suppressed image as channel 2 only, never replace the input (gridline and busbar are classes).
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + periodic-suppressed channel, 5 seeds. Baseline: house. Metrics: crack precision and IoU, gridline IoU. Kill: crack IoU < +0.012 or gridline IoU drop > 0.02.
